name: Eagle Shaman
summary: A shaman with this totem calls upon the noble eagle, stern and proud, soaring high above the world with keen and pitiless eyes that miss nothing.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: An eagle shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a bird (eagle). If choosing a domain, the eagle shaman must choose from the Air, Animal, Nobility, and Weather domains.

features.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
features.summary: An eagle shaman can use wild empathy with birds as a full-round action with a +4 bonus.

features.name: Totem Transformation (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, an eagle shaman may adopt an aspect of the eagle while retaining her normal form. This ability functions as the bear shaman ability, but the druid may select from the following bonuses: movement (fly speed 30 feet [average], the druid must be 5th level to select this bonus), senses (low-light vision, +4 racial bonus to Perception), or natural weapons (bite [1d4], 2 talons [1d4] for a Medium shaman). While using totem transformation, the eagle shaman may speak normally and can cast speak with animals (birds only) at will.

resourceActions.label: Activate Totem Transformation

modes.label: Flight
modes.summary: Gain a 30-foot fly speed with average maneuverability.

activeEffects.label: Eagle flight
activeEffects.description: Gain a 30-foot fly speed with average maneuverability.

modes.label: Senses
modes.summary: Gain low-light vision and +4 racial bonus on Perception checks. +4 racial bonus on Perception checks.

activeEffects.label: Eagle senses
activeEffects.description: Gain low-light vision and +4 racial bonus on Perception checks.

modes.label: Natural weapons
modes.summary: Gain a bite and two talons (1d4 each for Medium).

activeEffects.label: Eagle natural weapons
activeEffects.description: Gain a bite and two talons (1d4 each for Medium).

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 minute of Totem Transformation and apply the selected aspect for 10 rounds.

resourceActions.label: Speak with eagles, rocs, and giant eagles

confirmations.label: The target is one of the permitted eagles, rocs, and giant eagles

resourceActions.summary: At-will speak with animals, restricted to eagles, rocs, and giant eagles.

features.name: Totemic Summons (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, an eagle shaman may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action when summoning eagles, rocs, and giant eagles (added to the 4th-level list), and these summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to her druid level. This ability otherwise functions as the bear shaman ability.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Totemic Summons

confirmations.label: The summon creates eagles, rocs, and giant eagles

modes.label: Young (spell level -1)
modes.summary: Apply the young template and reduce the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Normal
modes.summary: Use the normal summon spell level.

modes.label: Advanced (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the advanced template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Giant (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the giant template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Advanced + giant (spell level +2)
modes.summary: Apply both templates and increase the required summon spell level by 2.

activeEffect.name: Eagle Shaman Totemic Summons
activeEffect.description: Summoned eagles, rocs, and giant eagles gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level; track their summon duration separately.

resourceActions.summary: Cast summon nature's ally as a standard action for eagles, rocs, and giant eagles; summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, an eagle shaman’s wild shape ability functions at her druid level – 2. If she takes on the form of an eagle or roc, she instead uses her druid level + 2. This ability replaces wild shape.

resourceActions.label: Assume Shaman Wild Shape

activeEffects.label: Favored wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level +2.

activeEffects.label: Adjusted wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level -2.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 wild shape use and track the correct effective druid level for the selected form.

progressionProfiles.label: Wild Shape Effective Level
progressionProfiles.summary: Effective druid levels used by normal and totem-favored wild shape forms.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, an eagle shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: Flyby Attack, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Perception), or Wind Stance. She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats. This ability replaces venom immunity.

mechanicalNotes: Nature Bond restrictions, Wild Empathy, daily transformation minutes, aspect modes, at-will animal speech, template-aware summons, effective wild-shape levels, and all bonus-feat slots are automated.
